en: Color postcard showing a roadside hotel with a red-tiled roof, balconies and an outdoor terrace with umbrellas and parked vans, set among pine trees and hills. The facade reads "HAN TURISTIC" and above the entrance "HOTEL." A tall roadside sign reads "HANUL BRAN." The reverse has Romanian handwriting dated 16 august 1982, three yellow Romanian 2 LEI stamps marked POSTA ROMANA with Brașov postmarks, and printed details for Hanul Bran with a price in lei.
